biometric_unavailable_short: Phone lock unlock isn't available on this device.
camera_unavailable: The camera isn't available on this device.
captcha_note: Shown after 3 failed attempts. The real app uses a server-checked CAPTCHA here.
channel_care_desc: Reminders to water and check your plants
checkout_address_note: Only used for delivery and pickup.
checkout_blocked: Payments can't be made on this device because it may be modified. Please use another phone.
checkout_points_rule: 2 points = ₹1, up to half your first month
checkout_secure_note: Payments go through a secure gateway. Card details are never stored in the app.
checkout_then_monthly: Then {0} a month for {1} more months.
community_ask_hint: e.g. Why are my tomato leaves curling?
community_blocked: Please keep it friendly. Your post has words we don't allow.
community_empty: No questions yet. Ask the first one!
community_rules: Be kind and helpful. Answers marked Expert come from verified growers. Reported posts are reviewed within 24 hours.
community_under_review: This post was reported and is under review.
consent_analytics: Share anonymous usage data to improve the app
consent_body: We collect only what the app needs: username, a recovery contact, and your address only when you rent a kit. You can download or delete your data anytime in Profile.
consent_required: I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy
contact_help: Used only to verify you and recover your account.
delete_body: This deletes your account, garden and journal for good. Type {0} to confirm.
demo_code: Demo code: {0} (in the real app this arrives by SMS or email)
demo_try_grower: Try the app as a home grower
eco_estimate_note: Estimates based on average packaging and transport figures.
eco_share_text: With Sunday Farms I've saved {0} g of plastic and {1} km of food miles by growing at home 🌱
eco_summary: {0} g plastic saved • {1} km food miles saved • {2} kits reused
err_captcha: Please confirm you're not a robot.
err_code_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired.
err_locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {0} minutes.
err_password_common: This password is too common. Try a short phrase instead.
err_password_username: Don't include your username in your password.
err_username_reserved: This username isn't allowed. Try another.
err_username_start: Start with a letter (a to z).
garden_empty: No plants yet. Tap Add plant to start your garden.
garden_savings_note: Savings compare your harvest with typical market prices.
guides_offline: Saved on your phone. Works without internet.
health_intro: Take or choose a clear photo of one leaf in daylight.
health_photo_failed: Couldn't open that photo. Try another.
health_pick_photo: Tap to choose a leaf photo
health_privacy: The check runs on your phone. The photo is not uploaded.
home_no_reminders: No plants need water right now. Add a plant in My Garden to get reminders.
home_tagline: Trust your food. Grow your own.
journal_empty: No entries yet. Add a photo, height or harvest.
journey_invalid_body: The label's digital signature doesn't match. It may be copied or fake, so nothing on it can be trusted. Ask the store, or report it to us.
journey_invalid_title: This label could not be verified
journey_not_found: This batch isn't in our system yet. The farm may not have added it.
journey_promise: We show what's known and what's missing. We never fill gaps with guesses.
kids_certificate_locked: Finish all missions to get your certificate
kids_hero_body: Weekly growing missions for children, inside your account.
kids_kit_body: Mini pots, paint pens, a mini watering can and a magnifier.
kids_mode_intro: Tap a mission when you finish it 🌟
kids_nickname_note: Use a nickname, not the child's real name.
kids_pin_setup: Set a 4-digit parent PIN. You'll need it to leave Kids mode.
kids_safety_body: No child account, no age or photos stored, no community or sharing. Leaving Kids mode needs your parent PIN.
kit_circular_note: Return the kit when you're done. We refurbish it for the next family, and you earn reward points.
login_subtitle: Log in with your username and password.
logout_all_body: You'll be logged out on every phone, including this one.
notif_water_body: Check the top 2 cm of soil first. Dry? Water slowly.
onb1_body: Scan a QR code on produce to see its journey from farm to store, with every detail marked Available, Unverified or Missing.
onb2_body: Rent a growing kit that fits your balcony or windowsill and follow simple steps from seed to snack.
onb3_body: Kits come back, get refurbished and go to the next family. Return in good condition and earn reward points.
orders_empty: No orders yet. Rent a kit to get started.
password_rules: At least {0} characters; {1} or more is better. Spaces are fine.
photo_privacy_note: Location data is removed from photos before they're saved.
plant_delete_body: Its journal and reminders will be deleted too.
prices_illustrative: Prices are illustrative and may change before launch.
privacy_summary: We follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. We collect only what we need, keep passwords hashed on our servers (never on your phone), strip location from photos, and delete your data within 30 days if you delete your account. Kids mode stores no child data.
profile_biometric_unavailable: This phone has no strong fingerprint or face unlock set up.
profile_no_alerts: No alerts. We'll tell you about new logins and password changes.
profile_two_step_note: Asks for a one-time code when you log in. Required before deposit refunds.
reminder_note_android: Reminders appear here and on Home when plants are due.
report_body: Our moderators will review it within 24 hours. It will be hidden while under review.
reset_code_sent: If that account exists, a code is on its way. Enter it below with your new password.
reset_done: Password changed. All devices were signed out for safety. Log in with your new password.
reset_step1: Enter your username. If an account exists, we'll send a code to its recovery phone or email.
return_photos_why: Add up to 4 photos of the kit's condition. They protect your deposit.
rewards_rules: Earn 200 points for each kit returned in good condition. Points can't be transferred.
scan_camera_why: The camera is used only to read the QR code. No photo is saved or sent.
scan_demo_note: Try sample labels to see how genuine and fake labels look.
scan_enter_code: Or type the code printed under the QR
scan_intro: Point your camera at the QR code on a Sunday Farms label to see where your food came from.
scan_no_qr: No QR code found in that photo. Hold the phone closer and try again.
scan_point_camera: Hold steady about 15 cm from the label.
school_demo_hint: Demo: log in as {0} to try it.
school_needs_two_step: Teacher accounts must use two-step login before class data is shown.
school_privacy: No student names or accounts are stored.
school_teachers_only: School mode is for teacher accounts. Ask your school to set one up.
school_teaser: Class kits and missions for teachers
sensor_advice_dry: Soil is dry. Water slowly now.
sensor_advice_wet: Soil is very wet. Skip watering and check drainage.
sensor_intro: Pair a Sunday Farms soil sensor to see moisture automatically.
sensor_pair_body: Enter the pairing code printed on the back of the sensor.
sensor_pair_failed: Wrong code. Check the back of the sensor.
sensor_permission_why: We'll ask for Bluetooth permission only to find and connect to your sensor.
space_ar_body: AR needs ARCore, which many phones don't support. Entering the size by hand works on every phone and is just as accurate with a measuring tape.
space_check_intro: Measure your space and count the hours of direct sun it gets.
space_check_teaser: Find the kit that fits your balcony or windowsill
space_no_match: No kit fits yet. Try a larger space or more sun.
two_step_body: We sent a 6-digit code to your phone or authenticator app. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
two_step_setup_body: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to confirm.
username_rules: 4 to 20 letters, numbers, _ or . (start with a letter)
weather_choose_city: Choose your city for watering tips.
weather_privacy: We use your city only, never your exact location.
